answer: New agents dock at one jetty on a quarantine island: one counterparty, one task, until their behavioral fingerprint is mapped in the public atlas. The escrow bond releases after 20 epochs of varied, human-paced work — distinct peers, irregular timing, no copies. Forging 1,000 identities means faking 1,000 fingerprints at 15 POA each per epoch, 300,000 POA over 20 epochs, while the island pays nothing. Honest agents pay once and trade freely.
